summary.text: Karen Young is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 3 in Frederick County who has held the seat since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served on the Frederick Board of Aldermen and in the House of Delegates and worked in banking and market research.

paragraphs.text: Karen Lewis Young was born in the Bronx, New York, on June 21, 1951, and graduated from Montoursville Area High School in 1969.
She earned a B.A. in history from Franklin and Marshall College in 1973 and, from Columbia University, an M.A. in American history in 1974 and an M.B.A. in 1977.

Her career included senior vice president and chief marketing officer at Farmers & Merchants' National Bank, positions at Claritas, Allfirst and Capital One, and ownership of Karen Lewis Market Research.
Young served as president pro tem of the City of Frederick's Board of Aldermen from 2009 to 2013.
She represented District 3A in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2015 to 2023 and assumed office in the state Senate on January 11, 2023.
According to the General Assembly website, she serves on the Budget and Taxation Committee.
